en: Topic guide — what do these subjects study?
Select a topic to filter papers

These browsing tags overlap: a paper can belong to several topics. Counts show this bibliography, not the number of papers in the whole field. A topic with zero papers still has a learning explanation; it does not imply a publication here. Use the topic filter with year, author role and search. “Mass spectrometry” is the usual term for measuring masses; optical spectroscopy measures spectra.
zh: 主题指南：这些方向研究什么？
这些浏览标签允许重叠，一篇论文可以属于多个主题。数量仅表示本页面的论文，不是整个领域的文献数。零篇主题仍提供学习说明，并不表示作者在该方向已有论文。主题可与年份、作者角色和搜索组合使用。“质谱”通常对应 mass spectrometry；光学光谱测量的是光谱。
